selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with a spindle cell neoplasm, positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, and the absence of cKIT and PDGFRA mutations support the diagnosis of wild-type GIST.

rejected.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1)
rejected.why: Although the patient tested positive for NF1, the clinical presentation and biopsy results more strongly support the diagnosis of GIST.
